name: Sarah
quote: The past 30 days at the Warsaw center have been fantastic. Honestly, for my children’s ongoing development coming to Growing Kids I feel was the best decision I made.

name: Kayla
quote: We have had such a great first month with Growing Kids Warsaw center! Our infant room teachers have been so wonderful and take such great care of our daughter while we are at work.

name: Jessica
quote: I have two of my children going to Growing kids in Goshen. I love how caring my kids teacher are with them.

name: Marissa
quote: I am happy to share our experience with you from Growing Kids Chesterton. We have attended for a year or more. My kids have attended daycare, after school care and summer camp here. We are definitely happy with the services and curriculum.

name: Kelsey
quote: I absolutely love this daycare as do my children. We have been with Growing Kids for almost 8 years! My children have always called daycare “school” and that’s just what it is. The children have time to play of course, but everything they do is centered on learning.

name: Jeni
quote: My kids were at Growing Kids SR23 for a total of 7 years. We still use GK for summer camp, winter camp, spring camp, and the occasional day off school.
